name: ticket-card
title: Ticket
description: A ticket that feels like one — a boarding pass with a flight path, or an admit-one concert and cinema ticket. Real cut-out notches the screen shows through, a perforated stub with a scan code, seven themes from paper to neon, a holographic badge that shimmers as it tilts, a rubber stamp that thumps down, a flip to a big code and notes — and a stub you can swipe off along the tear line.
